newsitem.title: USA: Brunswick Technologies raises IPO terms.
newsitem.headline: Brunswick Technologies raises IPO terms.

text.p: Brunswick Technologies Inc BTIC.O has raised the price for shares to be offered in its coming initial public offering, according to documents filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

The company now aims to raise about $20 million from the IPO, offering 2.0 million shares for $9 to $11 each. It first estimated it would offer 2.25 million shares for $6-$8 each, which would have raised gross proceeds of about $16 million.
